answers.drew: I love that entertainment unifies people. Getting to work in live music has been so rewarding because I get to be a part of the behind-the-scenes world that brings people together to enjoy a performance. I have met so many creative, kind, incredible, hard-working people in this industry, and it is really something I want to be a part of.
